title: Lufeng Formation, Yunnan: the Lufengosaurus fauna
summary: Red-bed strata of the Lufeng Basin in Yunnan, China, hold the Early Jurassic Lufengosaurus fauna, dated by one museum to about 195–190 million years ago. Lufengosaurus, a plant-eating prosauropod, shares the beds with other sauropodomorphs such as Yunnanosaurus and Jingshanosaurus, plus theropods and ornithischians, found in digs since the 1940s.

uncertainty.note: Numeric range 195–190 Ma is the Australian Museum's figure for Lufengosaurus; the Acta Palaeontologica Polonica paper gives the stage as Hettangian–Sinemurian and the type locality as Shawan Member (Hettangian), which can reach older than 195 Ma. Uncertainties are editorial allowances.

where.modern_name: Lufeng County (Shawan area), Chuxiong Prefecture, Yunnan, China
where.historical_name: Lufeng Basin, southwestern China (Early Jurassic); no polities existed

importance.justification: Classic Early Jurassic dinosaur fauna of Asia, type locality of Lufengosaurus.

sources.title: Vertebral fusion in two Early Jurassic sauropodomorph dinosaurs from the Lufeng Formation of Yunnan, China (Xing et al. 2015)

beats.caption: Red-bed strata of the Lufeng Basin in Yunnan, Early Jurassic in age, hold a rich dinosaur assemblage called the Lufengosaurus fauna.
Shawan village area is the type locality of Lufengosaurus huenei, a plant-eating prosauropod, in the Shawan Member.
Digs since the 1940s also yielded Yunnanosaurus, Jingshanosaurus, theropods and ornithischians from the same basin.
